featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Diesel shortage
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul diesel to Kingman Arizona! 👀  

> Coastline Mining has an urgent shortage of diesel to run all their mining equipment and request your assistance!

The event takes place on the **26th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P01ZlW49IXHTy)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/37508.1787823642.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul diesel  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Coastline Mining in Kingman.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/a4ebd34d-accb-4852-9da9-5633020befb0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **San Francisco** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120680-official-ats-convoy-animal-transporting/)**!

today.description:
#  Herbst-Konvoi der Spedition Rostock 2026

today.description:
# 🍂 Hello Autumn with GTLEGION — September

## 📖 About the Event

As summer comes to an end and a new season begins, **GTLEGION VTC** is pleased to invite the TruckersMP community to our special September event — **Hello Autumn with GTLEGION**!

This event is dedicated to welcoming the beginning of autumn with a large, organized community convoy through the beautiful roads of Europe.

Our goal is to bring together drivers from different VTCs and communities for an enjoyable, relaxed and well-organized convoy where everyone can enjoy the journey, meet other members of the TruckersMP community and celebrate the arrival of a new season together.


---

## 🍁 Event Concept

**Hello Autumn with GTLEGION** is a seasonal community convoy organized by GTLEGION.

The event will focus on:

* A large-scale organized convoy;
* Participation of multiple VTCs and communities;
* Safe and coordinated convoy movement;
* A relaxed and friendly atmosphere;
* Enjoying the autumn season together with the TruckersMP community;
* Bringing different communities together through one shared event.

The convoy will be managed by experienced event staff throughout the entire route.



-----



🍂 **Welcome, Autumn. Welcome to GTLEGION.**



-----

⭐ **Event Rules for Participants**

* The Event Staff are recognized as; “Elite | Staff" or similar.
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited
* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars and Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
* Advertising on the server is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Overtaking on the server is prohibited.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

⭐ **Event Rules for Event Staff**

* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

### Real Operations:
> Four (4) "Real Operations" scenarios have been approved by TruckersMP Event Management. This includes two (2) on a highway and two (2) on country roads. All operations have been reviewed and approved in line with our official rules. Any concerns regarding the actions or operations carried out by the Event Staff using the aforementioned tags should be directed to TruckersMP Event Management.

today.description:
**KCL FRACHTKONVOI**

Moin moin liebe Truckerfreunde, es ist wieder soweit.
Wir sind wieder auf **SIM 1** unterwegs und freuen uns über jeden Mitfahrer der uns begleitet.

----

**BITTE ANMELDEN!**

----

**Unsere Regeln:**

Bitte haltet euch an alle Regeln – sowohl an die Regeln von TruckersMP als auch an unsere Speditionsregeln.
Auch Fremdmitfahrer (die nicht zur KCL gehören) sind verpflichtet, diese Regeln einzuhalten.
Verhaltet euch außerdem stets respektvoll, freundlich und rücksichtsvoll gegenüber anderen Spielern.

Die KCL Piloten (keine Fremd Piloten) sind berechtigt, Konvois zu leiten sowie Änderungen und Anweisungen während des Konvois bekannt zu geben. Diesen Anweisungen ist Folge zu leisten!


Die KCL Mitglieder sind Verpflichtet die Speditionslackierung und den Tag zu nutzen.

Bitte nutzt die unten beschriebene Fracht und Auflieger!

**Bitte beachtet auch unsere Vorgaben und Regeln auf dem Discord!**

----

**Informationen:**

• Datum: 12.09.2026

• Treffen: 20:00 - 20:25 Uhr

• Start: ab ca. 20:30 Uhr

• Startort: Lamia [Brawen]

• Pausenort: Tirana [Parkplatz] 

• Zielort: Kragujevac [Ai Automotive] 

• Streckenlänge: ca. 1.708 Km

• Server: SIM 1

-----

**Regeln für den Frachtkonvoi!!!**

Für den Frachtkonvoi gibt es ein paar Dinge zu beachten! Frachtkonvoi bedeutet das wir alle zusammen eine Fracht an Ziel bringen wollen. 
Wie geht das? Kevin wird zu Beginn über Truckers MP einen Auftrag erstellen den alle Mitfahrer über das Tabmenü annehmen können.

**Regeln:**

• **Auflieger: Tiefbett: 1+4 Achsen, Ausziehbar, Lang**

• **Fracht: Lokomotive Vossloh G6**

• Fracht über SpedV Abrechnen und Fahren!


• vollgetankt am Start erscheinen und Zwischenstopp zum Tanken nutzen!

• Leistungsfähige Zugmaschine für schwere Fracht!

• wenig Schaden!

• Mit Fracht am Start stehen!

• Fracht am Zielort abgeben!

-----

**Wir fahren auf SIM1 – DLC: West Balkans & Greece NÖTIG!!**

----

**BITTE ANMELDEN!**

----
